title: How this founder built a better Duolingo with Codex | William Imoh
author: Claire Vo
description: Watch now (39 mins) | 🎙️ Hackmamba founder William Imoh shows the native app he built with Codex to learn Norwegian, and the Lord of the Rings Grok bot fellowship that helps run his company
summary: William Imoh is the founder of Hackmamba, a developer marketing company, and the creator of Mural, a real-time voice app he built to learn Norwegian after moving from Dubai to Norway. He has a chemical engineering degree, taught himself to code, and spent four years as a product manager, but he had never written a line of Swift.
takeaways: He has a chemical engineering degree, taught himself to code, and spent four years as a product manager, but he had never written a line of Swift.

In this episode, William shows how he used Codex and GPT-Live to build Mural natively for iOS and Android, then walks through the Lord of the Rings–themed Grok Bot “fellowship” that helps him run a team of about 25 as a solo founder.
